image_description: A high-angle shot of a stainless steel cooking pan containing three cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs are piled on top of each other, displaying their characteristic broad, oval carapaces with reddish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Multiple legs and claws are visible, though some are obscured by the overlapping arrangement. The lighting is warm, reflecting off the metallic surface of the pan and the glossy exoskeletons of the crabs.
